confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain given July peak demand and wide variation by district. Cocktail and wine_glass were set using their typical price relationship to the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5 to 3 times a draft beer; wine glass a modest premium over beer) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. Web search was used only for the RBA FX observation, taken from an rba.gov.au search excerpt rather than a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Central and Southeast European capitals of similar tourism scale and cost level, such as Sofia, Budapest and Warsaw, with Bucharest generally priced at or below them for restaurants and hostels. No specific comparable listings were used.
